name: state_timeline/default
description: A state timeline rendered with RectangleList: twelve machine lanes over two weeks, each split into thousands of short intervals colored by state, over faint full-height maintenance windows. Judge only content inside the plot; ignore the page heading, description, state swatches, check boxes, and slider.

checks.expectation: A single wide plot fills most of the window below the header. The Y axis is titled 'Machine' and has twelve text tick labels such as 'Press 1' at the bottom and 'Packer 2' at the top, each centered on a horizontal lane. The X axis is titled 'Time' and shows day labels such as 'Sun 8 Mar'.

Each of the twelve lanes is a horizontal band separated from its neighbors by a dark gap. Every band is filled edge to edge with many thin vertical segments, mostly green, with frequent grey and blue segments and scattered thin red segments. Segments are separated by thin dark lines. The lanes span the full width of the plot.
A few narrow, faint vertical bands of slightly different shade run the full height of the plot, visible in the gaps between lanes. They are subtle and must not hide the lanes.

Within the plot, axis titles and tick labels are readable and free of clear raster corruption. Fail only for concrete defects such as square pixel blocks, doubled glyphs, or severe stair-step edges that make plot text materially illegible. Do not compare plot text with headings, the state swatch labels, or any text outside the plot. Normal antialiasing, small fonts, rotated text, and backend-specific softness are acceptable.
The plot is not blank, corrupted, reduced to a single solid rectangle, or drawn outside its plot area. The lanes consist of many distinct colored segments rather than one uniform fill.
